review.kicker.note: Small heading above the page title of the review deck, where the user approves or sends back the agents' work

review.title.note: Page title: a deck of cards, one per item an agent wrote, to approve or send back

review.tab.draft.note: Tab listing the items waiting for review; a count follows it

review.tab.changes_requested.note: Tab listing the items the user sent back to the agent for changes; a count follows it

review.tab.approved.note: Tab listing the items the user approved; a count follows it

review.filter.all_chapters.note: Option of the chapter filter that shows every chapter

review.filter.all_kinds.note: Filter chip that shows items of every kind (events, entities, verses…); a count follows it

review.error.note: Label of an error box, shown in capitals; the error message follows it

review.loading.note: Loading message while the review cards load; the interface adds an ellipsis

review.empty.drafts.text: Deck cleared. No drafts waiting: send an agent on a mission from Command.
review.empty.drafts.note: Shown when no items wait for review; 'Command' is the name of the start page, where agents are sent to work

review.empty.other.note: Shown when the chosen tab and filters have no items

review.agent_intel.note: Label, in capitals, of a box holding the notes the agent left for the reviewer

review.your_orders.note: Label, in capitals, of a box holding the note the user wrote when sending this item back

review.action.back.note: Button: show the previous card; a keyboard key follows it

review.action.skip.note: Button: show the next card without deciding; a keyboard key follows it

review.action.open.note: Button: open this item in its own view (timeline, dossier, verse); a keyboard key follows it

review.action.send_back.note: Button: return the item to the agent with a note asking for changes

review.action.approve.note: Button: accept the item; a keyboard key follows it

review.orders.title.note: Heading of the box where the user writes what the agent should change; the agent reads it in its next session

review.orders.placeholder.text: What should the agent change? It will see this first in its packet.
review.orders.placeholder.note: Placeholder of the note box; a packet is the task file the agent reads before working

review.orders.hint.note: Keyboard hint under the note box; {send} and {cancel} are key symbols (⌘↵, Esc)

review.provenance.title.note: Side panel title: who wrote this item and when

review.provenance.status.note: Field label: the review status of the item

review.provenance.model.note: Field label: the AI model that wrote the item

review.provenance.skill.note: Field label: the agent skill (role and version) that wrote the item

review.provenance.written.note: Field label: how long ago the item was written, e.g. '3 h ago'

review.history.title.note: Side panel title: the review decisions made on this item

review.history.empty.note: Shown in the history panel when nobody has reviewed the item

review.up_next.note: Side panel title: the next cards in the deck

review.card.missing.text: This item is not in the linked bundles
review.card.missing.note: Shown on a card whose item the database lacks (the bundles are the compiled database)

review.causality.note: Small heading over the list of cause and effect links of an event

review.first_at.note: Where an entity or ritual first appears; {verse} is a reference like 1KGS.17.1

review.confidence.note: How sure the agent is, as a percentage; {percent} is a number like 85

review.entity.no_tipnr.note: Shown when a person or place has no identifier in TIPNR, the reference list of biblical names

review.entity.meaning.note: Field label: what a name means (its etymology)

review.entity.also.note: Field label: other names the entity goes by

review.entity.position.note: Field label: the map coordinates of a place

review.entity.via.note: Where the coordinates come from; {source} is a dataset name, e.g. 'via OpenBible'

review.component.target.note: Who or what a state is directed at; {entity} is a name chip

review.component.supersedes.note: This state replaces an earlier one; {id} is that state's identifier

review.instance.significance.note: Label, in capitals, of a box explaining what a ritual or mechanic means in the story

review.verse.literal.note: Label of the word-for-word translation of a verse

review.verse.dramatic.note: Label of the free, dramatic translation of a verse

review.verse.commentary.note: Label of the historical and linguistic commentary on a verse

review.verse.baseline.note: Label of the traditional translation (such as the KJV) when its name is unknown

review.verse.open_xray.note: Link to the verse in the X-Ray view, which shows a verse word by word

review.causal.overlaps.note: Shown instead of the time between cause and effect when the two events overlap in time

review.system.occurrences.note: How many times a ritual or mechanic occurs in the text

review.translation.english.note: Fold-out under a translation's review card, showing the English source
